name: 条件種類と件数付き優先度候補を並べる多段絞り込みメニュー
prompt:
Recreate the two-stage Linear filter menu from the primary original screenshot crop. Match the corrected source crop's portrait aspect ratio (529:854, about 0.62:1) and preserve both overlapping white popovers, their rounded corners, thin borders, subtle shadows, exact widths, row spacing, icon positions and the selected Priority row. The source screenshot controls geometry and icons; use the Japanese mock only for translated labels. Keep the two menus as the component on a clean white background without readable issue-list content behind them.

The tall right-hand menu has a top search/add field 「条件を追加…」 with the small F shortcut key at right; then these rows in source order, each with its matching fine gray icon and right chevron where shown: 「AIフィルター」, 「高度なフィルター」, 「状態」, 「担当者」, 「エージェント」, 「作成者」, 「優先度」, 「ラベル」, 「関連」, 「提案された分類」, 「日付」, 「案件」, 「案件の属性」, 「購読者」, 「自動終了」, 「内容」, 「リンク」, 「テンプレート」. Preserve the selected 「優先度」 row's light-gray highlight and darker priority-bars icon.

To its left, aligned with the selected Priority row, place the smaller priority submenu with a search field 「条件を検索…」 and exactly five rows: 「優先度なし」 with 13件, 「緊急」 with no count, 「高」 with 14件, 「中」 with 2件, and 「低」 with no count. Preserve the source's distinct priority glyphs, muted count text, subtle dividers, and alignment. Do not add counts to 緊急 or 低, and do not omit the no-priority count.

Use restrained white and cool-gray surfaces, fine neutral borders, light shadows, crisp compact Japanese UI type and source-matched spacing. Do not add page chrome, extra menu items, selected values, avatars, or background text.
reviewNotes: Candidate aspect 987x1593 (0.6196) matches corrected source crop 529x854 (0.6194). Side-by-side review confirms both menu panels, selected Priority row, submenu alignment, icon/row structure, and source counts 13/14/2 with no counts added for Urgent or Low. Corrected crop restores the clipped submenu border.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
